protocol.timing_baseline: Same-stage F of the same case/repeat; no previous-phase timing denominator
protocol.budget: b limits each partial step background target count to floor(b*N_background); non-core parts of each whole 2x2 tile are indivisible
protocol.actual_budget: Report used background/N_background, active target/N_target, full8 sum(active target)/(8*N_target), and unused cap separately; none is an actual latency ratio
protocol.age: Oldest-first scheduling has no hard maximum-age guarantee; full steps 1/8 and always-active R2 core are retained
protocol.operation: Real target Q/K/V/MLP plus complete condition/text; selected K/V/velocity are jointly refreshed; no Value correction or teacher in deployment
protocol.planner_timing: Only B125/B250/B333/B500 rebuild all eight step policies inside each request e2e; F/R2 use frozen static policies with zero selection seconds; do not subtract candidate planner time
protocol.quality: Unmasked RGB LPIPS Alex spatial map; old R0 evaluation core/bands and unchanged old allowed-box far background; repeat0 only
protocol.formal_target: Numeric quality and >=10% e2e latency reduction plus semantic/boundary pass; these three repeatedly viewed demos cannot establish formal Go
protocol.limits: No quality guarantee from budget, age, area or lower LPIPS alone; no learned controller, RL, independent test, confidence interval, significance or noninferiority claim

validation.scope: Integrity, numerical contracts and execution accounting; not semantic or algorithm-quality acceptance
validation.provenance_scope: Producer asserts full rebuilt-policy equality after timed requests; metadata/count/age/shape checks and independently reconstructed frozen policies are verified here; full per-request rebuilt index lists were not separately exported

visual_review.scope: Non-blind development inspection; not a human study, OCR score, identity proof, or formal quality acceptance
visual_review.views: Four-column INPUT/F/R2/candidate core and boundary panels for text, shirt and hair; seven-column overviews; tool may resize display while stored crops retain original pixels
